item.title: 88cc-Powered 1970 Honda CT70 Trail at No Reserve
item.description: This 1970 Honda CT70 Trail was refurbished under prior ownership and acquired by the seller in 2017. The bike was refinished in metallic red and is powered by a replacement CT70H-sourced four-stroke single with an 88cc piston and cylinder paired with a four-speed manual transmission.
